notes: No dollar price estimates are stored in this file. Every service except visits, home health, hospice and Tier 1 drugs is 40% coinsurance after the deductible, so the documents give no dollar price; enter allowed prices in the evaluator's section 2 (Costs).
Ultrasound is classified with MRI, PET and CT (one imaging cost share: 40% after the deductible).

assumptions: Deductible applies = true for emergency transportation, hospital, delivery, inpatient and other outpatient mental health, rehabilitation, habilitation, skilled nursing and durable medical equipment: they are not on the plan page's list of services covered before the deductible.

The '$1 for the first two visits' rule is recorded on primary care, outpatient mental health office visits and chiropractic. The plan page says the two visits cover primary care, chiropractic, hearing exams and MH/SUD together, so the real total across all of them is two; the evaluator counts the primary care discount only.
Dental: adult dental care is listed under excluded services, so cleanings, root canals and crowns are recorded as not covered.
notes: The plan page says HSA eligible: Yes. The plan type is HMO, and the out-of-pocket maximum ($23,600 family) is above the usual HDHP cap, so the evaluator may show an HDHP warning; confirm eligibility with the carrier.
Drug tiers 2 to 4 are 40% coinsurance with no dollar price in the documents.
Mail order is 90 days at 2.5x the retail copay for Tier 1 and Tier 2; Tier 4 is 30 days.
SBC coverage examples are self-only coverage.

Rechecked on 2026-10-27 against AB Select Bronze 61836WA0050036-01.pdf and the Healthplanfinder compare page: premium, deductibles, out-of-pocket maximums and the dental terms (cleaning, root canal, crown, annual maximum) match this file.
